prompt.text:
Implement `buildAlbumView` and export exactly `module.exports = { buildAlbumView }`. It accepts an array of album objects and optional options `{ query, limit }`. Every album must be a plain object with exactly `id`, `title`, `artist`, and `cover`; all four values are non-empty strings, and IDs must be unique. Options, when present, must be a plain object containing no fields other than `query` and `limit`. `query` defaults to `""` and must be a string; `limit` defaults to the album count and must be a non-negative safe integer.

Filter albums whose title or artist contains the query using case-insensitive matching, preserve input order, and then take at most `limit`. Return a fresh frozen object `{ total, cards }`, where `total` is the number matching before limiting and `cards` is a frozen array of fresh frozen objects `{ id, heading, subtitle, image }` mapped from the album fields. Empty inputs or zero limits return an empty cards array. Inputs must never be sorted, mutated, retained, or exposed through aliases. Malformed values throw `TypeError`; duplicate IDs or an invalid limit range throw `RangeError`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
